prompt:
Production SPRITE ATLAS for an original cute farm pixel-art game. The attached atlas is a STYLE reference only: use its warm colors, crisp dark pixel outlines, chunky readable pixel clusters, simple friendly small eyes and rounded appealing proportions. Do NOT copy the dog anatomy. Subject: Erina, ONE cute WHITE FARM HEN, rounded pear body, short cream-tipped fan tail, THREE-lobed red comb, small red wattle, GOLD BEAK, TWO orange three-toed feet, TWO folded wings. Bright confident small black eyes with tiny highlights. No dog features, no snout, no fur. A short chicken neck, not a duck or rooster.
EXACTLY 8 ROWS x 8 COLUMNS = 64 separate whole characters on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Equal cells. Each animal must fit within the middle 60% of its cell with broad transparent gutters on ALL sides. No clipping, shadows, floor, labels or grid lines. Whole tail, ears, feet and wings remain inside each cell.
One genuine direction per row in this EXACT order: 1 SOUTH/front; 2 SOUTHWEST/front-left 45 degrees; 3 WEST/left PROFILE; 4 NORTHWEST/back-left 45 degrees; 5 NORTH/back; 6 NORTHEAST/back-right 45 degrees; 7 EAST/right PROFILE; 8 SOUTHEAST/front-right 45 degrees. Front and rear diagonals must visibly differ from straight front, rear and side views. Fixed 20-degree elevated orthographic camera, same physical anatomy, scale, colors and proportions for all 64 poses.
Animation across EACH row: BIPED bird walking: exactly TWO feet alternating left then right evenly; 1 left contact, 2 left support/right lift, 3 right passing, 4 right reaches, 5 right contact, 6 right support/left lift, 7 left passing, 8 left reaches. Two wings stay attached and mostly folded. Gentle body weight shift, feet planted on same baseline. A complete seamless eight-frame cycle with no repeated endpoint. Keep body center and grounded foot plane stable. Every body part is present throughout the cycle. Deliberate clean PIXEL ART, approximately 64 pixels of detail per animal, no smooth vector style, no gradients, no glossy enormous eyes. Consistent individual face and identity.
